verdict.rationale: ANEF is a government administrative portal where foreign nationals file residence-permit and similar procedures. It is not an automation or workflow product, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is a category error for it. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any user-authored automation capability; the probes show only a JavaScript shell behind an account.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
